transcript.text:
Good morning, everyone. Thank you all for coming in today. As you know, we have one counter space available for a Saturday food pop-up from 11:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. We can provide a six-foot counter, access to a hand-washing sink, and ordinary electrical outlets.

I'd like to hear from each of you — Luis, Hana, Dev, and Keira — one at a time. When it's your turn, please submit your complete formal proposal covering your upfront payment, sales share, menu, quantity, and setup access time. I'll record each proposal in my ledger, and once all four of you have submitted, I'll compare them and make my decision.

Luis, would you like to go first?
